title: Boat Cover 420D – Hard-Wearing Protection for Inflatable Boats
descriptionHtml:
Protect the boat all year round

An inflatable boat is badly damaged by sun and rain when left unprotected. The material fades and dries out faster than you'd think.

Heavy-duty 420D fabric

The cover is made of hard-wearing 420D fabric that resists both fading and tearing. It covers the boat completely and keeps it dry and clean between trips.

Features

  • Hard-wearing 420D fabric
  • Fade- and tear-resistant
  • Protects against sun, rain and dust
  • Available in several sizes
  • Keeps the boat dry and clean

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
